description: Conditionally loaded reference graph with two closed profiles, formal-bend/v1 and contract/v1. Every canonical node declares its supported profiles. Selection filters profile before loading and follows unconditional requires plus only the selected requiresByProfile branch. Omitted profile preserves Formal compatibility. Uncompiled conditions remain manual advisory guidance, never approval. Fresh role contexts resolve their full current-profile closure without continuation assumptions.

bundleContract.purpose: Deterministic pre-joined reads of the same reference bytes. A bundle exists to stabilize the prompt prefix so a repeat session hits the cache, and never to summarize or replace node content.
rules: A bundle is optional. Reading its nodes individually is always valid and produces the same bytes.
Report the node ids in the lane header, never the bundle id.
Never hand-edit bundles/ — edit the reference node and regenerate.
A bundle contains every requires edge of its declared nodes, in dependency-first order.

A continuation bundle (`after`) delivers only the nodes its base bundles did not; the header lists the assumed nodes. Read it only when the base bundle's nodes are already in this same context. Fresh specialists never inherit a parent's assumed nodes and must load the full applicable bundle or their role node with dependencies. Reading base + continuation equals reading the full lane node set once.
delivery-lane is entry-only. Later phase reads come from oracle-run status; resolve their reference-graph dependencies, reading only missing applicable nodes.
